name: Whether a named method departs from its standard definition
summary: Asks, once per function or class that names a well-known method, whether its body departs from that method's standard definition. The methods and their definitions come from the versioned list crates/coder-one/src/departures/standard-methods.json.

per_finding.instructions: The implementation in `{finding}.body` departs from the standard definition of a method it names: each entry of `{finding}.methods` gives a method's name and its standard `definition`. A departure is a result the standard method wouldn't give, such as a biased form where the unbiased one is standard, a missing edge case the definition handles, or a state change the definition rules out. A different but equivalent computation isn't a departure.
